## Highlights since 0.15.3

- **Notes from the .tex on the PDF.** Annotations made in a .tex file now also show on the PDF, on the words they belong to, with the same marks, pins and cards as notes made on the PDF.

## Notable fixes

- Marks on the PDF follow their words after a rebuild that changes only some pages.
- Choosing Select All from the menu and then typing now always replaces everything.
- The in-browser demo opens PNG figures as images, loads images in Markdown notes, shows a placeholder while it starts, and explains that Source control runs in the Mac app instead of showing an error.
- The README links the browser demo and the release notes, and the project now has a code of conduct.
